name: camphor (natural) + lidocaine + menthol
purpose: Purpose External Anesthetic Purpose External Analgesic Purpose External Analgesic
uses: Use For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints
otcwarn: Do not use More than one patch on your body at a time On cut, irritated or swollen skin On puncture wounds Over raw surfaces or blistered areas For more than one week without consulting a doctor If you are allergic to any active or inactive ingredients If pouch is damaged or opened Stop use and consult a doctor if Condition worsens Redness is present Irritation develops Symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days You experience signs of skin injury, such as pain, swelling or blistering where the product was applied
